$scopeFlag: [Flag] This single contract covers BOTH a Kenya balloon product (Masai Mara / Fig Tree Camp take-off) and Tanzania products (Tarangire, Serengeti, Ngorongoro balloon take-off sites, and Elephant Rock Luxury Camp accommodation). Only the Masai Mara / Kenya line is in this project's default scope per CLAUDE.md — the Tanzania figures are recorded below for completeness/awareness only, clearly labeled, not for use in a Kenya-only itinerary.
contractParties: Signed rate agreement between Mada Collection and Sunworld Safaris, dated 04 August 2025 (per document's own signature block).
ratesInclude: VAT, government levy, landing/concession fee for hot air balloon, and service charge. Rates are NET and non-commissionable.

kenyaMasaiMaraBalloon.seasonality: Flat rate across all date bands stated (01.01 - 31.12, both 2025 and 2026) — no seasonal variation shown for this specific take-off site, unlike the Tanzania sites in the same table.

tanzaniaBalloonSitesOutOfScope.note: Recorded for awareness only — Tanzania is excluded from this project's default scope per CLAUDE.md.

elephantRockCampTarangire.noFlyPeriods: some windows marked 'No Fly' in source

elephantRockCampAccommodationOutOfScope.note: Tanzania accommodation rate (Full Board, Superior Tent) — out of scope, recorded for awareness only.

optionalExtrasStatedInContract.note: These extras are listed generically in the contract without specifying which take-off site they apply to — treat with caution for a Kenya/Masai Mara booking.
optionalExtrasStatedInContract.confidenceNote: [Unverified] These optional extras (lunch, night game drive, sundowner) read as generic Mada Collection lodge add-ons and may apply primarily to the Tanzania (Elephant Rock) side of the contract rather than the Kenya Fig Tree Camp balloon product. Confirm applicability before including in a Kenya quote.

circuitDiscountOutOfScope: 3%/5% accommodation discount tied to nights at Elephant Rock Luxury Camp (Tanzania) — not applicable to a Kenya-only booking.
childPolicy: Under 5 sharing with 1-2 adults: free. Age 5-12 sharing with 1-2 adults: 50% of adult sharing rate. Age 5-12 sharing own room (2-3 children): 75% of adult sharing rate.
